description: Put USDC to work in the APEX/USDC pool on Arc (eip155:5042) from your own key, non-custodially: call grow(minApexOut) on the ArcGrow contract with the USDC as native value; half is swapped for APEX, both halves become a full-range Uniswap v4 position minted to the caller, leftovers refunded, nothing kept. Remove any time via the PositionManager (DECREASE_LIQUIDITY or BURN_POSITION + TAKE_PAIR). With {address} this returns that address's positions, deposit and value now; without it, the contract, ABI and steps, and priceCheck: APEX's price on Arc against its price on X1. While they are more than 10% apart, do not deposit (half the USDC would buy APEX at that premium); our own page refuses then.

address.description: Optional: an Arc address to read positions for.

name: arc_grow
